`final class UniformSampler`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.uniform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UniformSampler.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/uniform/UniformSampler.java)

One sampler of a shader, its texture unit and the texture, filter and wrap bound to it.

## Description

The constructor of [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/) creates one per sampler of its stages, numbered from unit `1`: the backend keeps unit `0` for its own use.
At each draw, the render bridge resolves each sampler with `resolveSampler`, which falls back to the texture of the render state when the sampler has no allocated texture.
